findings.summary: campaignJobSection bounded a workflow job with a lowercase-only regex, so a section bled into the next job and a campaign job with no cache steps passed
findings.acknowledgementNote: the fix landed; the thread reply is still owed (plan S1.6, an after-merge duty)

findings.summary: proposals to replace FNV-1a for content addresses with SHA-256
findings.justification: decided: fnv1a addresses identity, SHA-256 covers integrity digests over canonical bytes. The two answer different questions and neither is a weakening of the other.

findings.summary: effect-residue.ts string-context blindness and whole-file allowlist suppression reported as fail-open
findings.justification: intentional: RED is the fail-closed direction for this scanner, so the reported behaviour is the safe one. Re-argued and re-rebutted more than once.

findings.summary: install Playwright browsers with --with-deps in CI
findings.justification: the pinned ubuntu-24.04 image contract already supplies the system dependencies; --with-deps would re-install them on every run for no verdict change.

findings.summary: audit --profile floor dispatch reported as unguarded
findings.justification: refuted and already pinned by tests/unit/cli/dispatch-subcommand-arity.test.ts, which enumerates the catalog identities rather than sampling them.

findings.summary: rename findings against the pre-LiteShip brand surfaces, and ADR/docs-era references
findings.justification: those surfaces are deleted, not renamed. A finding against them is a finding against bytes that no longer ship.

findings.summary: build a scanner that detects test titles whose polarity contradicts their assertion
findings.justification: polarity is not decidable from text; an approximate scanner over an open grammar would emit noise forever. The one live instance was fixed by hand, deliberately without a guard.
